程序包 org.bukkit

接口 ChunkSnapshot

public interface ChunkSnapshot
Represents a static, thread-safe snapshot of chunk of blocks. 代表区块（方块集合）的静态、线程安全快照。

Purpose is to allow clean, efficient copy of a chunk data to be made, and then handed off for processing in another thread (e.g. map rendering) 其目的是允许对区块数据进行干净、高效的复制，然后交给另一个线程处理（例如地图渲染）
